snippet.title: Road Trip: Shifting Gears. [GBA - Electronics Application, Conspiracy Ent.]. (2004). Full Play.
snippet.description:
.Played By PiE. - "April 10th, 2025".
.
.INFO.
 Road Trip: Shifting Gears continues the Takara-developed racing series on the GBA, and has the ability to link to Road Trip: Arcade Edition on the GameCube for unlockable extras. Players have full control over car customization, down to the most minute detail with a body paint shop, more than 100 different parts, and numerous fantasy attachments. Players compete in 150 racing events, minigames, in more than 64 courses.
.
.DISCLAIMER.
Some Games On this Channel use Save States. No cheats are used.
.

00:01:15 - Road Trip
00:29:19 - Sprint Race, Road Trip Cups cleanup
01:47:10 - Battle Race, Everything so far cleanups
02:08:41 - Grand Prix, Everything so far cleanup
02:53:00 - End Game Credits
02:55:00 - Bonus Road trip, Cups and everything cleanup
04:39:58 - Game complete, Shop clean up and no ending
.
